/repos/ValeraZSD/terramentor/pulls/331.title: Hosted guard and first-password setup fixes

commit.message:
Hosted guard: trimmed flag, absolute-form paths

isHosted now trims TERRAMENTOR_HOSTED like the start-up check does, and the site library asks isHosted instead of its own exact test, so a value such as '1 ' no longer starts a copy with every hosted rule off. requestPath reads an absolute-form request line (PUT http://host/api/ai/key) by its pathname and drops a fragment, which is how the router routes both.

Signed-off-by: ValeraZSD <valerazsd@gmail.com>

First-password setup for devices; quieter log

A device this computer already let in (a connected device, the owner's Tailscale) sets the first password without the code from the server log, as this machine does; any other remote request still needs it. The setup code is printed when it is made and then at most once a minute, instead of on every status poll.

Signed-off-by: ValeraZSD <valerazsd@gmail.com>

Describe what the health check does

Signed-off-by: ValeraZSD <valerazsd@gmail.com>

Guard hosted paths as the router parses them

The guard now reads the path the router itself parsed (baseUrl + path) instead of the raw request line, so spellings such as http:///api/ai/key, a port out of range or an empty host after @ are refused too.

Signed-off-by: ValeraZSD <valerazsd@gmail.com>
